description: This file defines the TransferManager class, which manages file transfer operations including queuing, status updates, and initiating device-to-device transfers via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct. It supports simulated cloud transfers and real hardware transport mechanisms, handling transfer progress, state, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: TransferManager
classes.description: Manages file transfer operations, queues transfers, tracks their statuses, and supports device-to-device as well as cloud-based transfer simulation.

methods.name: enqueueShare
methods.description: Enqueues a file transfer for cloud simulation.

methods.name: enqueueDirectShare
methods.description: Starts device-to-device transfer using specified transport type (Bluetooth or Wi-Fi Direct).

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Handles the actual file sending over a PeerSession.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates transfer status and progress in the internal map.

methods.name: simulateTransfer
methods.description: Simulates a transfer progress for cloud transfers.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Posts the updated transfer status list to LiveData observers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides singleton access to the TransferManager instance.
